goal.objective: Reconstruct and recover work after the prior worker stopped returning expected transition information to the single StegVerse heartbeat without reviving the ended claim or widening authority.
success_predicates: Prior lifecycle is reconstructed from durable checkpoint and Master Records evidence
Old worker instance authority remains ended
Any parent-task successor acquisition uses a separately authorized higher fencing generation
failure_predicates: Missing response is treated as a second heartbeat clock
Old claim or fence is reused
Recovery executor performs parent inference work

task.derivation_reason: Operational orphan recovery after the expected worker-response threshold was exceeded on the common heartbeat sequence; this is continuity recovery, not authority-bearing goal succession.

activation.recheck_trigger: each canonical heartbeat after the recovery-only authorization is durable

completion.next_authorized_action: The dedicated recovery executor verifies the ended HB25/G20 lifecycle against locally materialized canonical Master Records custody and writes only the recovery receipt. PASS releases this recovery task; the parent may then independently acquire a new fence greater than 20.
terminal_when: Reconstruction receipt is durable and Master Records evidence is bound
Old claim and fence remain unusable
Recovery task reaches COMPLETED without granting parent execution authority

block.recheck_trigger: each recovery-worker heartbeat invocation until canonical Master Records lifecycle custody is locally materialized and validates PASS
block.escalation_condition: reconstruction evidence is contradictory, the old claim/fence appears live, or recovery attempts parent inference execution
